findings.text: The negative-control paragraph presents the recorded mutant as the plan's stated control, but the mutation (`manifest_path = ... or ""`) makes `_queue_batch` fail the queue-time contract, so logs/negative-control-mutant.log reddens all three cases at queue time (`refused: 1`) and never reaches the edit path the plan's control names; the edit-path refusal is demonstrated separately by test_a_request_stored_without_a_manifest_path_cannot_be_edited, so the record's claim is true of the gate but not a transcript of the control the plan specified.

justifications.durability: the node adds no assertion, so nothing new guards this change; the behaviour it certifies is guarded by tests/test_a_batch_request_can_be_edited.py:143 (a queue-time path assertion spelled independently of the run_dir helper) and tests/test_a_batch_request_can_be_edited.py:184 (the refusal), and the recorded mutant shows those three cases redden when the assignment is dropped.
justifications.evidence: logs/base-arm.log and logs/after-arm.log each header the revision, tree and command and end on a bare `EXIT=0` over `54 passed`, and logs/negative-control-mutant.log ends `EXIT=1` over `3 failed`, so the done_when's 54-passed pair and a red mutant are recorded rather than claimed.
justifications.fit: the fragment is named for the node id as reckon/evidence.py:697 compose_landed_record requires, uses the `data-node` section shape that 671 of the 1812 fragments under docs/evidence/fragments/ use, and introduces no identifier the naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:734 carries `node.manifest_path = node.manifest_path or str(run_dir(run_id) / "manifest.md")` identically at base 4c4cf23439 and head ca8b937b1f, so the section's deliverable (batch-made requests editable in the queue) holds at the head; the node's own contribution is the verification record rather than a product change.
justifications.reuse: no definition is added or forked: the fragment re-records the existing `_queue_batch` assignment and the existing tests/test_a_batch_request_can_be_edited.py, and the search for an owner of a batch queue-time manifest path found `_queue_batch` (reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:734) already owning it.
justifications.scope_discipline: the whole diff at ca8b937b1f is one new file, docs/evidence/fragments/a-queued-request-is-checked-when-queued/ready-a-queued-request-is-checked-s6.html (53 insertions), and `git diff 4c4cf23439:reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py ca8b937b1f:...` plus the same for tests/test_a_batch_request_can_be_edited.py are both empty.
